web_sources.verified: CSI lists MasterFormat2026, edition-aware official access via its authorized partner; detailed full hierarchy was not retrieved.
Primary authorized publisher orientation confirms broad HVAC equipment/distribution/piping/controls/testing and coordination with adjacent divisions; guide is not a complete subsection list.

conflicts_or_limits: Notebook answer overgeneralizes some guide specification options as universal mandates. Bracketed options, spec-writer notes and VA-specific conditions are not adopted as universal rules.

Notebook answer assertion that accessory components must all be separately itemized is not adopted. Assembly boundaries, procurement responsibility and scope evidence are required to avoid double counting.
Two newly retrieved indexed source hashes differ from expansion snapshots. Current retrieved passages were reverified and both identities retained; no claim that earlier body bytes are unchanged.
Public orientation does not prove full MasterFormat2026 leaf coverage. Freeze the applicable edition and verify its complete section register before claiming all-subdivision coverage.
